units.title: Hear, Read & Repair Czech
units.description: Useful words, Czech sound and spelling clues, vowel length, phrase rhythm, and repair phrases for real communication

units.title: Meet Someone
units.description: Choose a formal or friendly greeting, exchange names and origins, repair fast speech, and close naturally.

units.title: People and Things Around Me
units.description: Ask who or what something is, identify familiar people and objects, and retrieve nouns with useful ten, ta, or to gender cues.

units.title: Who I Am and What I Have
units.description: Exchange simple facts about identity, status, and everyday possessions with být and mít.

units.title: What I Do
units.description: Talk about working, studying, living, speaking, reading, and understanding in simple exchanges.

units.title: Get What You Need
units.description: Request food, drinks, and everyday items politely in a Czech café or shop.

units.title: My Things and Your Things
units.description: Ask about belongings and identify owners using common possessive chunks.

units.title: My Family and People I Know
units.description: Introduce family and important people, then give simple descriptions.

units.title: Numbers and Making a Plan
units.description: Exchange simple contact, time, and meeting details using numbers and everyday scheduling language.

units.title: My Day
units.description: Understand and describe a simple daily routine in chronological order.

units.title: Order Food and Pay
units.description: Choose food and drink, place a polite restaurant order, ask for the bill, and say how you will pay.

units.title: Choose and Buy Clothes
units.description: Ask about colour, size, and price, try something on, compare simple choices, and complete a purchase.

units.title: Talk About Free Time
units.description: Say what you like doing, ask about another person’s interests, use frequency words, and make a simple plan.

units.title: Find Places and Get Around
units.description: Ask where a place is, follow and give a short route, and choose suitable transport around town.

units.title: Talk About Weather and Travel
units.description: Understand a simple forecast, connect seasons to plans, prepare a trip, and give a short travel update.

units.title: A1 Skills Practice
units.description: Independent A1 reading, listening, writing, and speaking practice for everyday Czech. This is not official examination material, is not affiliated with an examination provider, and gives no examination result or prediction.

units.title: A1 Real-Life Consolidation
units.description: Bring the A1 course together through café, shopping, directions, and planning missions that recycle useful everyday language.
